caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing human figure, positioned on a square pedestal. The figure is dressed in a tunic or robe that is primarily brown, with areas of lighter beige, and blue-green accents. The statue features a headdress adorned with three prominent upright feathers—one blue-green and two brown. The figure's hands are clasped at the center, holding a cylindrical object. The statue is rendered in brown tones to mimic wood grain, with details such as facial features, hair, and folds in the clothing visible. The pedestal the figure stands on is gray, creating contrast with the warmer colors of the statue. The background is plain and light, keeping focus on the statue itself.
